episode.learning_goal: 理解 interrupt、checkpoint 与 human-in-the-loop 的关系

item.title: Human-in-the-loop - LangGraph Docs
item.content:
## Overview [露出:高]
Human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows integrate human input into automated processes, allowing for decisions, validation, or corrections at key stages.
## interrupt [露出:高]
The interrupt() function pauses graph execution at a specific node and surfaces a value to the client (e.g. a draft for review). To resume, the client invokes the graph again with Command(resume=value); the value becomes the return value of interrupt() inside the node.
## Requirements [露出:高]
HITL requires a checkpointer: graph state is persisted at each step, so a paused run can be resumed later — even after the process restarts — from the saved checkpoint using the same thread_id.
## Design patterns [露出:低]
Approve or reject an action; edit graph state; review tool calls; validate human input.
## Caveats [露出:无]
When resuming, the node containing interrupt() re-executes from the beginning, so side effects before interrupt() run again; place side effects after interrupt() or make them idempotent.

related_entries.name: Human-in-the-loop
related_entries.summary: 在 Agent 执行过程中插入人工审批或输入节点，让人参与关键决策。
related_entries.body_markdown:
## 定义
在 Agent 执行过程中插入人工审批或输入节点，由人确认后再继续。
## 实现方式
在需要人工介入的节点暂停执行，等待用户输入后继续。
## 常见场景
- 工具调用前审批（如发邮件、付款）
- 让用户修改 Agent 生成的计划

related_entries.name: Checkpoint
related_entries.summary: LangGraph 在每个 super-step 结束时保存图状态快照，用于记忆、容错与时间回溯。
related_entries.body_markdown:
## 定义
LangGraph 在每个 super-step 结束时把图状态保存为 checkpoint，按 thread_id 组织。
## Checkpointer 实现
- MemorySaver：内存，测试用
- SqliteSaver / PostgresSaver：持久化，生产用
## 用途
- 对话记忆（同一 thread 继续）
- 失败后从最近 checkpoint 恢复
- 时间回溯（replay / fork）

ops.heading: ## 中断与检查点
ops.markdown:
The `interrupt()` function pauses graph execution at a specific node and surfaces a value to the client (e.g. a draft for review). To resume, the client invokes the graph again with `Command(resume=value)`; the value becomes the return value of `interrupt()` inside the node.

HITL requires a checkpointer: graph state is persisted at each step, so a paused run can be resumed later — even after the process restarts — from the saved checkpoint using the same `thread_id`.

ops.heading: ## 设计模式
ops.markdown:
Common HITL design patterns:
- Approve or reject an action (e.g., before sending an email or making a payment).
- Edit graph state based on human feedback.
- Review tool calls before they are executed.
- Validate human‑provided input.

ops.heading: ## 注意事项
ops.markdown: When resuming, the node containing `interrupt()` re‑executes from the beginning, so any side effects placed before `interrupt()` will run again. To avoid unintended duplication, place side effects after the `interrupt()` call or ensure they are idempotent.
